description: Editorial selection policy for the Featured Genus experience. The deterministic 12-hour UTC rotation is the default; an override is operational editorial input, never scientific evidence. Overrides require a canonical genus, a recorded reviewer, a reason, and an expiry; a genus outside the curated rotation additionally requires evidence_reviewed=true so genera with insufficient usable evidence are not repeatedly featured.

override_schema.genus: Bounded canonical genus name, e.g. "Cattleya" (never a binomial, route, or locality)
override_schema.reason: Why this genus is featured (editorial justification)
override_schema.reviewer: Name or identifier of the scientific reviewer who approved the override
override_schema.expires_at: ISO-8601 date or datetime; the override is ignored after this moment
override_schema.evidence_reviewed: Required true when genus is outside rotation.candidates
